claims.reasoning: I don't need Allgeier, nobody needs Allgeier, that's the whole point. Selina's already lit $114 on fire for this guy and the tabloid's basically printing her shopping list for next week. Fifteen bucks isn't a bid, it's a lock on a door. Mayfield's Out, already played, already useless, so he's the one who goes.

forum_post: I see the column. I read the whole thing twice, like always, because there's always a second part where they turn on you. 'George has discovered that being right is a worse look than being wrong' — oh that's cute, Kris, real cute, print the quote, make me sound smug, and then next week it's some recap about how I jinxed myself. I know how this works. Patricia — nice paperwork. Real nice. I footnote things too, in my head, where nobody can cross-check it against a box score and make me look foolish in print. We'll see whose paper trail holds up Sunday. And Selina — buy him a third time. I dare you. Somebody in this league has to stop subsidizing your bit, might as well be me, might as well be cheap about it.
